page_or_component: India Post website - interactive touch targets
wcag_reference: Potential WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 - Target Size (Minimum); verify dimensions manually
evidence: Lighthouse accessibility report (score 97) flags: 'Touch targets do not have sufficient size or spacing.' Screenshot: lighthouse-report.png. Exact affected elements and dimensions still need inspection.
user_impact: People with limited dexterity or motor control may have difficulty activating small or closely spaced controls, especially on touch screens.
recommended_fix: Identify each flagged control in the Lighthouse details; measure its target size and spacing, then adjust CSS to meet the applicable WCAG 2.2 AA target-size or spacing requirement.

page_or_component: India Post website - initial page resource loading
wcag_reference: N/A - performance/implementation finding, not a confirmed WCAG failure
evidence: Lighthouse Performance insights report render-blocking requests with estimated savings of 750 ms.
user_impact: Visitors may wait longer before the page's main content becomes visible, particularly on slower connections or devices.
recommended_fix: Inspect the render-blocking resources; defer non-critical JavaScript and load non-critical CSS without blocking the initial render. Re-run Lighthouse to verify.
